reason: I already carry a reusable bottle and fill it from my Brita at home, so I'm not buying bottled water to begin with. Paying almost $68 today plus a filter subscription on my income is a lot just to filter water I'm already okay drinking.
objection: I don't see what this does that my Brita and my current bottle don't, and a subscription that keeps shipping plastic filter cartridges doesn't feel any greener than what I have now.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the filters are recyclable or taken back, plus a test showing it removes something my Brita doesn't, at a bottle price closer to $30 with no subscription required.
